versions.subject: feat: new rules, updates and goofy guineapig stuff (#4229)
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
filter_main_legit_paths:
    - Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\Google\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\'
    - Image|contains: '\AppData\Local\Google\Update\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\GoogleUpdate.exe" Image="*\\GoogleUpdate.exe" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Program Files\\Google\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\*") OR Image="*\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Update\\*")
